text: Objective This objective is to train students to develop morally, intellectually and physically to meet the requirements of the socioeconomic development in the 21st century. After graduation, students should have solid professional foundation, wide-range knowledge, strong ability and innovative spirit; have high accomplishments of mathematics and economics; obtain the basic theories and methods of statistics; and skillfully use computer to analyze data. Students can work in enterprises or economic management departments at all levels for a various pursuits in the fields of statistic survey and consultation, information management, data analysis, application and management. Or students can also serve as teachers in schools, or as research staff or actuaries in research institutions. Core courses Mathematical Analysis, Analytic Geometry, Advanced Algebra, Probability and Statistics, Different Equations, Numerical Methods and Computer Technology, Introduction of Economics, Applied Regression Analysis, Statistics, Finance, Insurance Mathematics, Sampling Survey, Stochastic Processes, Nonparametric Estimation, Multivariate Statistical Analysis, Economical Risk Analysis, Measure Theory, Time Series Analysis, Humanities and Social Sciences. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.
